Leah (CS): Heads-up: Mariner QBR Wed 9am PT. Need token runway, 2 commit scenarios (conservative/aggressive), onboarding status, and one-line renewal ask. Can @Omar - FinOps own econ?

Omar - FinOps: I got it. Do we want 30d daily + 90d trend? Also include per-route percent.

Leah (CS): Yes to both. Keep slides tight 1-2 charts + one topline recommendation.

billing-bot: ALERT: mariner-acct crossed 82% of monthly commit. Link: https://billing.redwood.example/mariner-acct/usage

Omar - FinOps: Quick draft numbers: last30d tokens = 33,450,000; projected month = ~37.8M. If no throttles projected overage ~4.2M tokens (~$900 at current rates). I'll run commit sims.

Omar - FinOps: Query used:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, sum(tokens) FROM usage.events WHERE customer_id='mariner-acct' AND ts >= now()-interval '90 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;
```

Priya (SE): Onboarding: ingestion paused by client after yesterday's spike. Root cause = connector env mismatch. Hotfix pushed to staging, prod change needs their infra sign-off. ETA for prod fix Mon 4pm PT.

Evan (CSM): Customer asks to see: 1) per-route token breakdown, 2) suggestion for commit amount, 3) if quantized model will affect JSON outputs.

Omar - FinOps: Scenario sketches: A) no change = pay on-demand, est $9.1k/mo; B) conservative commit +10% = $9.9k/mo, reduces throttles; C) aggressive +25% = $11.4k/mo; with q2-micro-quant we estimate ~15% token cost cut but +4-7ms median latency. I'll include sample latency numbers.

Priya (SE): I tested q2-micro-quant on their templates: minor numeric rounding differences, one route needs template tweak. Recommend "templating review required" in risk notes.

Leah (CS): Owners: Omar (econ + charts + alerts), Priya (integration notes + risks), Evan (customer quote + commit ask wording), Leah (deck + runbook). Reconvene Mon 3:30pm PT for final review. :white_check_mark:
